alembic_version.ddl:
CREATE TABLE alembic_version (
	version_num VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT alembic_version_pkc PRIMARY KEY (version_num)
)

appeals.ddl:
CREATE TABLE appeals (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	violation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	restriction_id INTEGER, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT, 
	deadline DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id INTEGER, 
	result VARCHAR(32), 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	review_comment TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_appeals PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_appeals_reason_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(reason)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_appeals_restriction_id_restrictions FOREIGN KEY(restriction_id) REFERENCES restrictions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_appeals_reviewer_id_users FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_appeals_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_appeals_violation_id_violation_records FOREIGN KEY(violation_id) REFERENCES violation_records (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_appeals_appeal_result CHECK (result IN ('approved', 'rejected'))
)

arrival_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE arrival_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	arrival_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	arrived_at DATETIME, 
	arrival_method VARCHAR(32), 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	end_method VARCHAR(32), 
	sync_delay_seconds INTEGER, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_arrival_records PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_arrival_records_reservation_id_reservations FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_arrival_records_seat_id_seats FOREIGN KEY(seat_id) REFERENCES seats (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_arrival_records_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_arrival_records_arrival_status CHECK (arrival_status IN ('absent', 'on_time', 'late', 'early')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_arrival_records_arrival_method CHECK (arrival_method IN ('qr', 'manual')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_arrival_records_end_method CHECK (end_method IN ('button', 'auto_timeout', 'admin_release'))
)

audit_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	operator_id INTEGER, 
	op_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(64), 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	before_value TEXT, 
	after_value TEXT, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	result VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_audit_logs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_audit_logs_operator_id_users FOREIGN KEY(operator_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_audit_logs_audit_op_type CHECK (op_type IN ('admin_action', 'violation', 'permission_change'))
)

auth_sessions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	user_agent VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_auth_sessions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_auth_sessions_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_auth_sessions_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

calendar_days.ddl:
CREATE TABLE calendar_days (
	day DATE NOT NULL, 
	day_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(128), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_calendar_days PRIMARY KEY (day), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_calendar_days_day_type CHECK (day_type IN ('weekday', 'weekend', 'holiday', 'exam_week'))
)

entry_exit_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "entry_exit_records" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_system VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	masked_user_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	record_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	recognition VARCHAR(32), 
	received_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	sync_status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	sync_delay_seconds INTEGER, 
	reservation_id INTEGER, manual_note TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_entry_exit_records PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_entry_exit_records_entry_exit_type CHECK (record_type IN ('entry', 'exit')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_entry_exit_records_recognition_method CHECK (recognition IN ('face', 'card')), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_entry_exit_records_source_system_external_id UNIQUE (source_system, external_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_entry_exit_records_reservation_id_reservations FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

login_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE login_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	student_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	event VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	success BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(32), 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	user_agent VARCHAR(255), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_login_logs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_login_logs_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

notifications.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "notifications" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sent_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_notifications PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_notifications_notification_type CHECK (type IN ('reservation_confirmed', 'checkin_reminder', 'violation', 'maintenance', 'system', 'temp_leave')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_notifications_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_notifications_in_app_only CHECK (channel = 'in_app'), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_notifications_idempotency_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

opening_schedules.ddl:
CREATE TABLE opening_schedules (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	day_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	open_time TIME NOT NULL, 
	close_time TIME NOT NULL, 
	effective_from DATE, 
	effective_to DATE, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_opening_schedules PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_opening_schedules_effective_range CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= effective_to), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_opening_schedules_open_before_close CHECK (open_time < close_time), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_opening_schedules_room_id_study_rooms FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES study_rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_opening_schedules_day_type CHECK (day_type IN ('weekday', 'weekend', 'holiday', 'exam_week'))
)

password_reset_tokens.ddl:
CREATE TABLE password_reset_tokens (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	issued_by INTEGER, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	used_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_password_reset_tokens PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_password_reset_tokens_issued_by_users FOREIGN KEY(issued_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_password_reset_tokens_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_password_reset_tokens_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

permissions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE permissions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255), 
	resource VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_permissions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_permissions_code UNIQUE (code)
)

reservations.ddl:
CREATE TABLE reservations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reservation_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	start_time DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	end_time DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	cancel_type VARCHAR(32), 
	cancel_reason TEXT, 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	expire_reason VARCHAR(64), 
	remark TEXT, 
	temp_leave_at DATETIME, 
	temp_leave_state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, request_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_reservations PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservations_start_before_end CHECK (start_time < end_time), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_reservations_room_id_study_rooms FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES study_rooms (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_reservations_seat_id_seats FOREIGN KEY(seat_id) REFERENCES seats (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_reservations_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reservations_idempotency_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_reservations_reservation_no UNIQUE (reservation_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservations_reservation_status CHECK (status IN ('RESERVED', 'ACTIVE', 'TEMP_LEAVE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'ADMIN_CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED', 'TIMED_OUT')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservations_cancel_type CHECK (cancel_type IN ('normal', 'late', 'system')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_reservations_temp_leave_state CHECK (temp_leave_state IN ('none', 'waiting', 'returned', 'timed_out'))
)

restrictions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE restrictions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ban_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	warning_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	trigger_condition VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	start_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	end_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	lifted_at DATETIME, 
	lift_reason TEXT, 
	lifted_by INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_restrictions PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_restrictions_ban_days_positive CHECK (ban_days >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_restrictions_start_before_end CHECK (start_at < end_at), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_restrictions_lifted_by_users FOREIGN KEY(lifted_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_restrictions_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_restrictions_restriction_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'lifted', 'expired'))
)

role_permissions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	permission_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_role_permissions PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_role_permissions_permission_id_permissions FOREIGN KEY(permission_id) REFERENCES permissions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_role_permissions_role_id_roles FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

roles.ddl:
CREATE TABLE roles (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255), 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_roles PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_roles_name UNIQUE (name), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_roles_role_name CHECK (name IN ('user', 'admin', 'ops'))
)

seats.ddl:
CREATE TABLE seats (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	room_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	zone_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	has_power BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	by_window BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	accessible BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status_changed_at DATETIME, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_seats PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_seats_room_id_study_rooms FOREIGN KEY(room_id) REFERENCES study_rooms (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_seats_room_id_code UNIQUE (room_id, code), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_seats_zone_type CHECK (zone_type IN ('quiet', 'discussion', 'exam_prep')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_seats_seat_status CHECK (status IN ('available', 'reserved', 'in_use', 'maintenance', 'closed', 'disabled'))
)

study_rooms.ddl:
CREATE TABLE study_rooms (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR(128), 
	capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	facilities TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	remark TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, floor VARCHAR(32), 
	CONSTRAINT pk_study_rooms PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_study_rooms_capacity_non_negative CHECK (capacity >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_study_rooms_name UNIQUE (name), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_study_rooms_room_status CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed'))
)

system_settings.ddl:
CREATE TABLE system_settings (
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_by INTEGER, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_system_settings PRIMARY KEY ("key"), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_system_settings_updated_by_users FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

user_roles.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_roles (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_user_roles PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_user_roles_role_id_roles FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_user_roles_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

users.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	student_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR(128), 
	contact VARCHAR(128), 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_users PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_student_no_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(student_no)) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_users_student_no UNIQUE (student_no), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_account_status CHECK (status IN ('normal', 'disabled'))
)

violation_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE "violation_records" (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	violation_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id INTEGER, 
	arrival_record_id INTEGER, 
	description TEXT, 
	state VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	period_start DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	period_seq INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	archived_at DATETIME, 
	determined_by VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	restriction_id INTEGER, 
	appeal_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	is_offset BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_violation_records PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_violation_records_appeal_status CHECK (appeal_status IN ('none', 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_violation_records_user_id_users FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_violation_records_violation_state CHECK (state IN ('active', 'archived')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_violation_records_restriction_id_restrictions FOREIGN KEY(restriction_id) REFERENCES restrictions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_violation_records_violation_type CHECK (violation_type IN ('left_undeclared', 'no_show', 'no_checkout', 'late_cancel', 'temp_leave_timeout')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_violation_records_arrival_record_id_arrival_records FOREIGN KEY(arrival_record_id) REFERENCES arrival_records (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_violation_records_reservation_id_reservations FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_violation_records_violation_result CHECK (result IN ('warning', 'restricted'))
)
